modalLead: 📥 Inbox is here — a lightweight place to save links you want to read or sort later, separate from your bookmark pages. Press 0 to open it, paste a URL with Ctrl+V, or choose Save to Inbox in the browser extension. Triage walks unread items one by one; Promote turns a link into a full bookmark when you are ready.

items.text: Inbox page — capture links in data/inbox.json without a page or category. Open from the header tab, 0 (search closed), or :inbox. Disable under Config → General → Enable Inbox page.
Paste & extension — Ctrl+V on the dashboard offers Save to Inbox or Add bookmark; set a default under Paste URL default. Browser extension adds Save to Inbox with duplicate detection.
Inbox UI — filter All / Unread, search, date groups (Today → Older), load more, open / promote / delete with undo toast. Unread tab badge and discoverability glow only when unreadCount > 0.
Triage — one-by-one overlay: J/K move, O/Enter open, P promote, R/Space keep (mark read), D/Delete remove. Start from the page or :inbox triage.

Onboarding — one-time intro modal on the Inbox page; optional toast for existing users. Reset from Config → Advanced → System → Reset Inbox intro modal. Header shows lowercase inbox on the Inbox view.
i18n — Inbox UI, paste choice, commands, cheatsheet, extension strings, and Config → Help → Inbox in EN / NL / DE / FR.
Page overview — migrated to the shared AppModal shell: narrow centered panel, card-style rows with counts, keyboard nav, and focus-trap parity with recent / what's new modals.
Rotating tips — off by default for new and existing installs (showTips migration in models.go); enable under General → Dashboard or :tips on.
Command palette — :quicktag / :qt entry removed from the palette (use Shift+T on a selected row). Cheat sheet documents 0 = Inbox.
README, MANUAL, CHANGELOG & Config Help — v2026.07.06 release notes and Inbox documentation (EN/NL/DE/FR help prose).
Cache-bust — whats-new-v130 data version and 2026.07-dashboard-release-v99 dashboard release token; page-overview and inbox asset query strings.
